headline: DOUBLE DRAGON: hits have weight now
lede: Every blow on Walnuts Street moves bodies by its force: a jab rocks a thug, a kick drives him back, the flying knee flattens and carries him — and Abobo barely budges. Knockdowns skid along the asphalt before you stomp, and tearing free of a grip shoves the grabber off you.

notes.text: #2935 shipped: weight-true knockback — a per-strike velocity ladder scaled by the man's mass, a sharp down-skid, and the shove always runs away from your fist, never across the depth lanes.

Found and fixed a softlock on the way: unbounded knockback could park a thug past the camera's reach and a wave would never end — the screen is a wall now (bounds camX±16, the same margin the throwers' footwork keeps).

ddragoncheck grew 230 to 242 named laws and 208/208 mutants still go red and name their harm (new: knock-flat, bounds-off). Winnability re-measured after the physics change: solo 12/12, full run 12/12, co-op 6/6.
Same day on the other slot: R-TYPE gained the armed duelist that hunts you across lanes (#2934) and carriers that answer back when their pod is shot (#2937).
